definition: Alcoholism is a long-lasting disease involving alcohol use in which genetic, psychological, and environmental influences all play a role. It typically includes difficulty controlling drinking, strong mental focus on alcohol, continued use despite harm, and distorted thinking such as denial, and it may be ongoing or come and go over time.
